{{Top|leg}}
A '''repulsor web''' was used in [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]]. It was a field that stretched across the track and prevented [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]] from passing the start/finish post. The repulsor web was in place until the start of the race.
